messages:
Ada (PM): Quick sync — we need to nail launch slice SLAs + graceful degradation policy for console observability (dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics). cc @Sam @Ruth @Miguel
Sam (Eng): +1. What's the minimum acceptable latency and data freshness targets for GA vs. degraded mode? :thinking:
Ada (PM): GA target: dashboard 95th p95 < 350ms, traces tail < 500ms, cost queries ~2s. Degraded mode: allow up to 2x latency or reduced timeframe (last 6h only). Also must keep error-rate view accurate within 5%.
Ruth (Design): For degraded mode UX — do we surface a banner + 'live mode off' indicator, or hide some widgets? Need copy suggestions and states. :eyes:
Miguel (SRE): From infra POV, we can serve degraded mode by switching to precomputed aggregates and turning off high-cardinality traces. We should also rate-limit per-tenant heavy queries. Concern: cost of precompute storage vs. query CPU.
Priya (Customer Success): A few enterprise customers asked for per-tenant cost breakdown and hard SLA. They expect <5% missed alerts during rollout. They'll accept degraded views but want clear comms and opt-in for strict SLA.
Sam (Eng): Implementation sketch:
```yaml
policy:
  ga:
    latency_target_p95_ms: 350
    freshness: realtime
  degraded:
    latency_multiplier: 2
    freshness: '6h'
    features_disabled: [high-cardinality-traces, streaming-cost-drilldown]
routing:
  prefer_precomputed: true
  fallback_model: aggregate-only
```
Miguel (SRE): That looks good. Need autoscaling thresholds and an escape hatch to route specific tenants to dedicated capacity (Reserved Capacity). Also add a circuit-breaker metric for CPU>85%: auto-failover -> degraded.
Ada (PM): Questions for tradeoff discussion:
- What's the expected cost delta (query CPU + precompute storage) for supporting both modes?
- How many customers should be allowed to opt into strict SLA at GA?
- What diagnostic signals do we surface so support can triage degraded incidents?
Ruth (Design): For copy: banner text proposal — "Live metrics limited — showing aggregated results to ensure stability. See details or request dedicated capacity." CTA: Request SLA / View last updated.
Sam (Eng): For engineering prioritization: we need
1) tracing hook toggle per-tenant (2w)
2) precompute pipeline for 6h aggregates (3w)
3) cost breakdown materialized views (3w)
4) UX banners + telemetry (1w)
Estimate total 9 weeks if sequential, 5-6 weeks with parallel work and a small squad.
Priya (Customer Success): We'll compile a list of customers wanting strict SLA. Recommend pilot with 3 customers for GA.
Miguel (SRE): Also propose SLO alerting: degrade-warning when compute approaches 70%, degrade-enforce at 85%. And an incident runbook for degraded-mode (who to ping, how to roll back).
Ada (PM): Next steps: Sam to add cost estimate + prioritization tradeoffs by EOD Thu. Ruth to draft banner states & microcopy. Miguel to propose autoscale thresholds and runbook. Priya to provide pilot-candidate list.
Sam (Eng): Will do. I'll mock a cost model (delta t-shirt sizes) and include expected ops burden.
Ruth (Design): Drafting copy now, will post comps in #design-review tomorrow.
Miguel (SRE): I'll draft runbook snippets and the alerting rules. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 1733416400 to check progress on action items.
Ada (PM): Thanks all — aim to finalize policy in next planning sync. :rocket:
